title: Coinbase keeps neutral 3Q crypto outlook, says BTC may be entering accumulation
summary: Coinbase Institutional and Glassnode released a joint report that maintained a neutral outlook for the cryptocurrency market in the third quarter of this year. The report said the crypto market capitalization excluding stablecoins fell about 12% in the second quarter, while stablecoin supply reached a record high.It added that on-chain data suggests Bitcoin may be shifting from a correction phase into an accumulation phase. Signs of that transition include compressed valuations, active supply nearing multiyear lows, and the share of supply in profit falling below its historical lower bound.The report cautioned, however, that the macro liquidity backdrop remains tight. Under Kevin Warsh, the U.S. Federal Reserve has maintained a hawkish stance, while geopolitical risks, selling pressure from companies holding cryptocurrencies, and net outflows from spot BTC and ETH ETFs in the first half, with the pace of outflows now slowing, are also weighing on the market. Overall caution is warranted, according to the report.

summary: Bitcoin would likely rise sharply if a quantum-resistant roadmap is announced, according to Charles Edwards, founder of crypto investment firm Capriole Investments. If the core team makes that decision and unveils a roadmap, BTC would likely climb quickly, he said.Edwards added that an immediate Bitcoin gain following the release of a quantum-resistant roadmap would likely be in the double digits, or more than 10%. He also said Bitcoin is currently trading around 40% below its fair value based on the energy value consumed in mining, suggesting the quantum-computing threat is creating about a 30% discount.

title: Bitcoin profitability improves, but rebound signal remains insufficient: Cointelegraph
summary: Bitcoin’s key on-chain indicators are improving, but the latest setup could still end in another failed rebound signal, Cointelegraph said.The outlet said the share of BTC supply in profit rose above 50% in July, up from this year’s low of 46.2% on June 30. With around 60% of the total BTC supply now back in profit, the spent output profit ratio, or SOPR, for long-term holders is also improving. A long-term holder SOPR above one indicates profit-taking is dominant, while a reading below one suggests selling at a loss.Cointelegraph said the 30-day simple moving average of long-term holder SOPR would need to stay above one for several weeks, and overall supply in profit would need to exceed 64%, for the bear market to end. It added there was already one failed case in this cycle: from April 28 to June 1, the average long-term holder SOPR stayed above one for 35 days and supply in profit climbed as high as 67%, but both indicators later turned lower again. So far, the 30-day simple moving average of long-term holder SOPR has remained below one for more than 50 days.
author: @CoinnessGL
